project.name: Sylphx Dart
project.summary: Shared Dart and Flutter guidelines, analysis configuration, lint package scaffold, and Melos validation for Sylphx Dart projects.
goals: Provide repo-owned Dart and Flutter guidelines under docs/.
Own the sylph_lints shared lint package scaffold and package metadata.
Keep Melos bootstrap, formatting, analysis, and test guidance coherent for Dart repositories that intentionally consume this surface.
nonGoals: Own every downstream Dart application, Flutter product, app-specific analysis exception, or release process.
Own enterprise doctrine or package release infrastructure.
Own product UI, app workflow, deployment, or customer-specific behavior for repositories that consume the guidance.

owns.name: dart-guidelines
owns.description: The shared Dart and Flutter development guidelines, documentation, root analysis configuration, Melos workspace, and validation expectations in this repository.

owns.name: sylph-lints-package-scaffold
owns.description: The packages/sylph_lints shared lint package scaffold, package metadata, README, lockfile, and future reusable lint configuration surface.

doesNotOwn: Downstream Dart or Flutter application code, app-specific analyzer exceptions, product UI decisions, app release policy, or customer workflows.
Every consumer repository's CI workflow, branch protection, release process, or package manager policy.
Enterprise engineering doctrine and manifest schema owned by SylphxAI/doctrine.

publicSurfaces.name: Melos workspace and root package metadata

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema and engineering doctrine

forbiddenCouplings: Do not encode a consuming Flutter product's UI, routing, deployment, or customer-specific analyzer exceptions into the shared guidance surface.
Do not make consumers depend on unpublished internal paths when a package export or documented configuration should exist.
Do not fork doctrine standards into this repository.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests, pushes, and merge queue refs run Dart CI with Melos bootstrap, format, analyze, and tests. No package publication workflow is present at this baseline.
delivery.productionProof: Passing Dart CI plus representative consumer validation before shared analysis or lint package changes are treated as broadly adoptable.

gaps.description: Dart CI exists and supports merge_group, but branch-protection required contexts are not recorded in this manifest baseline.
README and package metadata still reference SylphLab/playbook naming; reconcile brand and doctrine links before full adoption.
Shared analyzer/lint changes should be validated against representative consumer repositories before full adoption.
